## Summary

Weifang Goertek Electronics holds 20 MA-L blocks in the IEEE registry, all at Weifang, Shandong, China addresses, most of them in the Weifang free trade or export processing zone [1]. The name ties it to Goertek, a Chinese acoustic components company founded in June 2001 by Jiang Bin and Hu Shuangmei, headquartered in Weifang with manufacturing in Vietnam, whose customers include Apple, Samsung, Sony, Lenovo, Fitbit, ByteDance and Huawei [2]. Goertek describes three businesses: precision components, smart audio devices such as TWS earphones and smart speakers, and smart hardware such as VR and AR headsets, smart wearables, gaming consoles and accessories, built for leading clients under ODM and JDM arrangements [3]. The fetched sources do not state this subsidiary's place in the group or its founding year, so those are unknown.

A MAC in one of these blocks is most likely a contract-built consumer device, earbuds, a smart speaker, a VR headset, a wearable or a console accessory, sold under a customer's brand rather than Goertek's [3]. Which brand, radio and chipset is not documented here: the FCC ID databases refused access from the session that wrote this entry, so radios, silicon and grantee codes are left empty rather than assumed. Randomization is unknown.
